copy.en:

PC+ABS shell, vertical ribs, four corner guards

design_brief_zh: 以creative_plan的hotspots版式为准，不采用旧设计说明中的左文右图布局。主卖点保留八轮360°转向，以四组双排轮的结构特写作为具体证明；随后从操控部件过渡至箱壳构造，回应用户对日常耐用结构、纹理及四个防撞角的关注。依据为用户提供的8轮、铝合金三挡拉杆、PC与ABS材质、竖条纹及四个防撞角；图片观察仅辅助外观，不证明材料比例或抗刮性能。PC画布2000×2000，以下坐标均为[x,y,w,h]比例：产品区[0.28,0.29,0.44,0.65]；slot 0标题[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.12]居中；slot 1支持说明[0.14,0.185,0.72,0.09]居中；slot 2拉杆细节[0.035,0.39,0.205,0.23]右对齐，引线通向[0.36,0.46]附近的拉杆细节证据；slot 3箱壳细节[0.76,0.39,0.205,0.23]左对齐，引线通向[0.64,0.46]附近的箱壳与护角证据。将对应实物局部裁切安排在锚点附近，勿将引线错接至锁具。轮组放大裁切位于产品区下缘，保留双轮之间的间隙及轮座，可配无文字转向弧线；避免为了露出八个轮片而扭曲轮组。Mobile画布1200×1200：产品区[0.18,0.29,0.64,0.39]，标题及支持说明框与PC同比例；slot 2位于[0.05,0.73,0.43,0.21]，左对齐，锚点[0.35,0.52]；slot 3位于[0.52,0.73,0.43,0.21]，左对齐，锚点[0.65,0.52]。两端均按标题、支持说明、拉杆、箱壳阅读，移动端重排而非直接缩小。主体为当前Sliver SKU的银色单箱，45度前侧视，保持真实竖纹、边框及护角形状；拉杆局部呈现套叠结构，不虚构三挡刻度。箱壳特写以掠射侧光展示竖纹起伏、护角覆盖与边框衔接，四角数量由用户事实支持，未露出的角件须取得对应实拍后补充，不凭空增加。背景为低饱和机场通道的轻微虚化，暖白#F5F3ED留白，深色#172B36文字、#01447B细引线。自然柔和侧光、接触阴影，避免将PC+ABS壳面拍成全铝材质。字体使用Arial/Helvetica/Amazon Ember风格，标题加粗，标题、支持说明、细节字号比例约0.066、0.037、0.033；各语言独立排版并预留20%扩展空间，每条文案可在框内自然折行，不添加新文案。缺口：未提供耐刮、耐磨、跌落或长期耐用测试，也未提供PC/ABS比例，故以结构展示回应耐用诉求，不表达防刮结论。
compliance_note_zh: 准确区分四组双排轮与总计八个轮片，不写成八组双轮。材质只使用用户提供的PC、ABS及铝合金信息，不称100%聚碳酸酯、全铝箱或航空级铝。四个防撞角为用户提供配置，不延伸为全方位防撞或抗冲击保证。无耐刮证据，不使用防刮、耐磨、划痕不显、长期如新等文字或钥匙刮擦、跌落无损等暗示性画面。机场与城市仅作使用场景，不宣称航空公司批准或登机尺寸适配。不使用其他图片中的竞品品牌或宣传结论。本方案为带文案的功能辅图，不适用于Amazon首张白底主图；若用作首图，必须另行制作无文字、无引线、无场景的合规产品图。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon secondary feature-image composition for the YWJ 13A suitcase, current SKU 13A-Sliver-20, with NO rendered text, letters, numbers, logos, badges or watermarks. Use one silver suitcase, not a set. Follow the supplied product appearance: vertically ribbed PC and ABS hard shell, aluminium frame, telescopic handle, corner guards and four twin-wheel assemblies totaling eight individual wheels. Do not make the shell look like solid aluminium. Visual story: first show wheel steering through a clear twin-wheel close-up and a subtle unnumbered turning arc; then show the telescopic handle construction; finally show the vertical shell ribs and corner-guard coverage in an authentic macro crop. No scratch resistance demonstration, impact effects, drop tests, material cross-sections or invented adjustment markings. Main suitcase in a 45-degree front-side view, soft natural side lighting and grazing light across the ribs, controlled highlights and soft contact shadow. Subtly blurred contemporary European airport corridor, warm off-white #F5F3ED background, restrained navy #01447B connector lines. PC composition: 2000x2000 square; normalized product region [0.28,0.29,0.44,0.65]. Reserve completely clean headline region [0.08,0.05,0.84,0.12], supporting-copy region [0.14,0.185,0.72,0.09], left callout region [0.035,0.39,0.205,0.23], and right callout region [0.76,0.39,0.205,0.23]. Place handle detail evidence near anchor [0.36,0.46] and shell/corner detail evidence near [0.64,0.46], with fine connectors toward their matching blank callout regions. Keep the wheel close-up inside the lower product region, do not distort the suitcase to expose hidden wheels. Preserve actual guard geometry; do not fabricate hidden corner details. Mobile adaptation: 1200x1200 square, product region [0.18,0.29,0.64,0.39], same normalized headline and supporting-copy reservations; bottom-left blank callout region [0.05,0.73,0.43,0.21] linked to handle evidence near [0.35,0.52], bottom-right blank callout region [0.52,0.73,0.43,0.21] linked to shell/corner evidence near [0.65,0.52]. Recompose for mobile rather than scaling the PC layout. Keep every reserved copy area empty; all typography will be added separately.
